purpose: UPlayground skill design concept illustrations; not game screenshots or runtime assets

images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: high resolution landscape six-panel combat art-direction board for the UPlayground hack-and-slash skill design document. Generate one coherent 3 columns by 2 rows contact sheet, wide 3:2 canvas, clean narrow dark gutters and equal-sized panels. Each panel is a beautiful production concept painting of the SAME small full-body anime swordswoman in navy and ivory lightweight armor wielding a single long sword, fighting dark armored humanoid monsters in a slate stone arena. Camera: consistent high isometric gameplay camera, full action footprint visible, not cinematic close-ups. Toon-shaded shapes, refined cel shading, mint-white cutting edges with lavender trails, dark navy environment. Clear readable ground and enemy silhouettes, restrained bloom.
Panel top left: three-hit basic sword combo summarized by a bright wide forward fan slash, two fainter preceding blade trails, three monsters in front. Label only "100–102".
Panel top middle: leaping downward sword slam, heroine landing at the center of a clearly bounded mint circular shock ring, short falling streak above, nearby monsters react. Label only "110".
Panel top right: forward dash double slash through a narrow corridor of monsters, translucent starting silhouette at lower left, actual heroine at upper right, TWO parallel diagonal sword arcs and a narrow straight movement trail. Label only "111".
Panel bottom left: spinning sword slash around the heroine, a low horizontal complete circular mint blade ribbon around her feet/waist, visible enemy silhouettes surrounding her, restrained lavender second trail. Label only "112".
Panel bottom middle: concentrated rapid triple strike against ONE large armored elite directly ahead, two small pale slash marks and ONE bright final diagonal impact, narrow forward footprint, no radial blast. Label only "113".
Panel bottom right: heroine at lower left releases ONE tall crescent-shaped sword wave traveling along the stone ground toward upper right through a line of three enemies, distant enemy clearly visible. Label only "114".
Constraints: gameplay VFX explanatory concept, not an actual engine screenshot; do not add HUD, stats, buttons, paragraphs, arrows, watermarks or any text other than the six ID labels. Do not depict gore. Keep slash volumes substantially different between panels. Show ground through effects, keep background quieter than action. All six panels equally polished and uncropped.
images.note: 114 shows sequential positions of one projectile; interpret as temporal trail, not two damage projectiles. 110 affects the filled disk inside the ring.

images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: landscape triptych art-direction illustration for UPlayground hack-and-slash BUILD EFFECTS. One image, three equal vertical panels, wide 3:2 canvas, thin dark gutters. Consistent high isometric gameplay camera, stone arena, same elegant white-haired female sword warrior in navy-and-ivory light armor, armored dark monsters, clean toon-shaded game concept style, restrained glow with highly readable ground. Concept only, no HUD.
Left panel labeled only "BLEED": warrior finishes a broad sword cut into a group. Show stylized thin crimson magical incision marks on monsters, a compact red burst at one defeated enemy that connects to two neighbors by thin red arcs. No blood or gore, magical geometric red fragments, tiny red rings under affected enemies. Keep the sword trail mint-white so red is the build modifier.
Middle panel labeled only "SHOCK": warrior delivers a sword impact to a large armored enemy. A low cyan concentric ground pulse and ONE fainter lavender echo ring expand around them; a clear cracked cyan shield sigil hovers briefly near the elite's chest to communicate armor weakening. Other enemies at edge, distinguish two timed waves with bright vs faint stroke; not a continuous ground hazard.
Right panel labeled only "FRENZY": warrior has dodged diagonally toward upper right; actual warrior at end is solid, and a single violet translucent sword-wielding afterimage remains at the lower-left starting point making one small circular slash against two close monsters. A short thin lavender trail connects departure to destination, broken amber small energy sparks near the real warrior imply consumed stacks. Afterimage stays at departure, not a clone army.
Lighting: quiet blue slate environment, bright local effects, no overexposure, no explosion wall. Detailed polished VFX concept art, clear silhouettes and spacious framing.
Text: ONLY the exact three short labels BLEED, SHOCK, FRENZY at top. No other text, numbers, logo, watermark.
images.note: Build effect timing and damage authority are defined in HackSlashSkills_Spec.md.
